_README: Hand-maintained party page redirects, merged over the ones derived automatically from related_parties.json (static_data/outputs/parties.py: build_party_aliases). Entries in `redirects` are { "from": "<retired page id>", "to": "<live page id>", "note": "<why>" } and are rendered into merger-tracker/frontend/public/_redirects as 301s by static_data/outputs/redirects.py. Only ids the derived map cannot reproduce belong here: (a) collision-suffixed ids (`-2`, `-3`), which a party only ever received because another party shared its slug at the time, and (b) parties the ACCC later renamed or re-identified, where nothing in the current data remembers the old name. A plain fold-in into a canonical group needs no entry — declaring the member in related_parties.json is enough. An entry whose `from` is a live page id is ignored: a real page always wins over a redirect.
